description: Shows several Claude subscription accounts' 5-hour and weekly limits, records their use, and switches the Claude desktop app and Claude Code between them.
notes: WindowTally is unpacked but not set up. Set it up from Windows PowerShell:
After scoop update, run the same command again: it replaces the installed copy and keeps your data.
Before scoop uninstall, run it with -Mode Uninstall, then the account sync's UninstallWatcher mode, as README.md says.
